doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Whether he was Doc Severinsen's high-note safety net
summary: Young denies ever covering high notes for Doc Severinsen and says Doc had chops.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Well, you were associated with the Tonight Show Band for thirty years.
Thirty years. A friend of mine asked me to ask you about being Doc‘s safety net for the high notes.
That you were Doc‘s safety net, if he couldn‘t make those high notes you were there to hit them for him. Is that correct?
No, I never had, no, that‘s a…
I never had to hit no high notes for Doc. Doc had…
No, that‘s what I‘m saying, if he couldn‘t hit it you were there to get it if he didn‘t get it. No?
No, Doc was, [laughs] Doc had some chops, man.
